title: Open-support comparison and raw exchange with supplied compactifications
statement: Use the finite commutative coefficient ring, compactifications, and unbounded derived compact support of [def-asd-open-restriction-comparisons] and [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. For a cartesian square a ≫ f = p ≫ j with a,j open immersions, and supplied compactifications cf of f and cp of p, define E(cf,cp) by graph comparison from cp to cf.ofIsPullback(sq), the proper/open exchange for cf.g, and the open composition comparison from the pulled-back open to a followed by cf.i. For any cartesian base-change square sq for f and any cf, define B(sq,cf) as the canonical raw compactification base-change map, made an isomorphism by finite-coefficient proper base change. Neither definition chooses an isomorphism from an existence theorem. No quasi-compactness is required. Pullbacks and inverse images are as in [def-pc-fibre-product] and [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].
